vedic_reference.note: The name Arti is derived from the Sanskrit word अर्ति (arti), which means 'desire, need, want'. In Hindu mythology, Arti is a name of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name is also used for the earthen lamp filled with oil and wicks, which is lit during religious ceremonies and puja (worship).
